findings.implication: C2 is false as written, but this does not refute same-SCC positive concatenation closure.
findings.interpretation: One pair of attachment points need not admit two paths whose interiors simultaneously avoid both cycles.
findings.next_step: Use arbitrary SCC paths P:u->v and Q:v->u; permit cycle traversal or distinct attachment points.
findings.observation: The preregistered strict connector normal form failed on 18272 cycle pairs (including controls).

findings.implication: A literal one-orbit-per-label ledger must separate its recurrent cycles; this is finite evidence aligned with the independent theorem proof.
findings.interpretation: Within the frozen positive finite class, cyclically distinct recurrent branches in one SCC close under concatenation to an additional primitive root.
findings.next_step: Promote only the repaired hypothesis, not the rejected strict normal form.
findings.observation: The repaired audit exhaustively checked 66066 graphs, 613996 shared-state pairs and 161475 connector pairs, producing 775471 mixed roots with zero failures.

findings.implication: These are finite controls and must not be merged with the complete n<=4 census.
findings.interpretation: The mechanism is graph recurrence, not arithmetic inventory.
findings.next_step: Keep the complete/control evidence classes separate in any paper table.
findings.observation: The 64 deterministic 5..8 vertex controls added 69073 mixed roots with zero repaired-C2 failures.

findings.implication: The selected determinant belongs to a label-dependent pruned operator, not to the unclassified recurrent object.
findings.interpretation: Terminal recognition is determinant-neutral until rejected recurrent blocks are deleted.
findings.next_step: Reject terminal orbitification/pruning as same-object arithmetic emergence.
findings.observation: A 160-state exact adjacency with 34 acyclic decision states had the same Newton determinant as its 126-state recurrent product for all eight post-freeze inventories; every proper nonempty pruning changed it.

findings.implication: They are regression witnesses only; noncompactness remains an infinite weak-null theorem.
findings.interpretation: The finite artifacts instantiate the premises of the Kraft-clock argument without floating-point approximation.
findings.next_step: Cite the analytic proof for noncompactness and label the cutoff table as a proxy.
findings.observation: All 12 q-ary/cutoff configurations passed prefix, Kraft, roof-share, and powered clock inequalities exactly.

findings.implication: First return is valid only as a changed-marker object.
findings.interpretation: Induction replaces graph-step length by return count.
findings.next_step: Enforce the z^ell-to-z firewall in subsequent candidates.
findings.observation: All 17 raw cycle factors differed formally from first-return factors and agreed after z=1.

findings.implication: The prototype does not close signed, matrix, supertrace, or nonlocal-weight programs.
findings.interpretation: Positivity is the coefficientwise no-cancellation hypothesis.
findings.next_step: Any such successor must prove source-natural cancellation and same-marker operator ownership independently.
findings.observation: The signed three-state control had determinant one, and orthogonal matrix branches killed mixed products while pure products survived.
